name: MoonSloth
description: The laziest memecoin on Solana. While degens FOMO and panic-sell, MoonSloth bags quietly and sleeps through every dip. Slow and steady ruins the rug-pullers. HODL in hibernation.

name: GigaBrain
description: Born from the collective intelligence of 10,000 crypto Twitter doomposters. GigaBrain calculates the exact moment to ape in, then ignores its own advice. Maximum galaxy-brain energy.

name: PumpGhost
description: Haunting Solana's mempool since the last bull run. PumpGhost appears from nowhere, spooks the charts, and vanishes before bears can react. You can't rug what you can't catch. Boo.
